jpy.head: USD/JPY tests 160 resistance amid intervention warnings
jpy.plain: USD/JPY has pushed to 10-week highs near the critical 160 level as hawkish Federal Reserve expectations support the greenback. However, growing fears of official currency intervention and rising bets on a Bank of Japan rate hike are limiting further upside.
pts: Upside appears capped near the 160 level as traders brace for possible official intervention to support the yen.
Speculation of a Bank of Japan rate hike is building while the pair tests major resistance.
Hawkish Fed sentiment is keeping dollar buyers active, though diverging central bank paths present risks in both directions.
jpy.watch: Fed Chairman Warsh's upcoming speech, followed by US Retail Sales data.
jpy.plan: Treat the 160 area with extreme caution, watching for sudden intervention headlines while monitoring upcoming US data.
